title: Renormalized Area of Catenoids in the Hyperbolic Space
summary: We show that the generating curves of non-totally geodesic spherical rotational minimal hypersurfaces (catenoids, for simplicity) of the hyperbolic spaces $\mathbb{H}^{2n+1}$ are $p$-elastic curves for $p=(2n-1)/(2n)$. We employ this variational characterization, together with the Chern--Gauss--Bonnet formulas for locally conformally flat manifolds, to present an explicit expression for the renormalized area of catenoids in terms of hyperelliptic integrals.
